args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy, checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. checkout-api was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions are on v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions. The service is passing health checks again, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) describes the failure, the rollback and the status afterwards. It also notes that the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before redeploying.

content.text: The most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
